svg.title: suez workflow
svg.desc: Step 1 learns a sample covariance shared by all genes; step 2 tests every cis-SNP with nested linear mixed models that use it.
svg.text: one sample covariance shared by all genes
for every gene g: yg = X bg + eg, eg ~ N(0, Σ)
X = condition design (removed exactly: REML on contrasts ⟂ X)
Σ = σ²noise I + σ²ind S + σ²kin K + Σp σ²p xpxpᵀ
Fitted jointly over all genes by maximum likelihood (Stan, L-BFGS);
run time does not grow with the number of genes.
every gene × every SNP within ± cisdist of it
y = C b + g β + e
y = C b + g β + (g·c) γ + e
e ~ N(0, σ²k K + σ² I), K = cov_suez
rotate by the eigenvectors of K: the
grid, then Newton at every local peak
genotype g split by haplotype ancestry:
LA = # AFR haplotypes, GAFR, GEUR = ALT on each
